title: Colour palette
subtitle: Replace the game's primary and accent colour pickers. Your palette loads through the mods folder — the game file itself is never modified.

actions.applyHint: Saves and loads this palette in Rocket League (restart the game to see it)

status.gameMissing: Rocket League was not found — set its folder in Settings to edit the palette.
status.unsupported: The colour pickers could not be located in this game build.
status.gameRunning: Rocket League is running — close it to apply or restore a palette.
status.stale: The game was updated since "{{name}}" was applied — it will be rebuilt automatically, or apply it again.
status.stockInGame: The game uses its stock colours.

library.empty: Your palettes will appear here. Start from the stock colours or a generator.

editor.linkHint: Edit blue and orange primaries together
editor.selectHint: Select a swatch to edit it.
editor.note: Rows are shades, columns are hues — the same layout as the in-game picker. A small dot marks slots changed from stock.

generators.rainbowHint: One hue per column, light to dark
generators.title: Quick fill
generators.hint: Replace the whole swatch grid shown above in one click.

toast.restartHint: Start (or restart) Rocket League to see it.

dialogs.discardBody: The palette you are editing has unsaved changes.
dialogs.deleteBody: This palette will be removed from your library.
dialogs.deleteActiveBody: This palette is in game: the stock colours will be restored first.

sections.libraryHint: Pick a palette to edit it, or start a new one from the game's colours.
sections.editorHint: Change the swatches, then save and apply the palette in game.
